title: Mac Miller Passes Away at the age of 26.
htmlContent: [caption id="attachment_500228" align="aligncenter" width="300"] Photo Credit - Mac Miller[/caption] Mac Miller was found dead in his Los Angeles home on Friday from an apparent drug overdose. He was 26 years old. His family released a statement saying, “Malcolm McCormick, known and adored by fans as Mac Miller, has tragically passed away at the age of 26,” they said. “He was a bright light in this world for his family, friends, and fans.” The artist recently released an album on Aug. 3, titled “Swimming” that has already peaked at number 3 on the Billboard charts.
